# MM-P1-L1-RR01 Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev B
Plant: P1, line P1-L1
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01

Scope
This document defines preventive maintenance tasks for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) at P1, line P1-L1. It covers mandrel clamp bolt torque verification and main roll bearing lubrication timing, and refers to machine safety and lockout procedures in SB-1025 and operational steps in SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated to the range required for mandrel clamp bolt application.
- Clean rags and approved lubricants per machine specification.
- Low lint brushes and grease pump suitable for bearing fittings.
- Lockout/tagout devices per SB-1025.

Procedure
- Isolate energy sources and apply lockout per SB-1025 before maintenance work. Verify isolation visually and by attempting normal start controls.
- Access mandrel clamp bolts following access guidance in SOP-P1-L1-01. Clean bolt threads and seating surfaces to remove debris and old lubricant.
- Set torque wrench to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01): 635 N·m. Apply torque evenly to each clamp bolt using a cross pattern to ensure uniform seating. Record applied torque in the equipment maintenance log.
- Inspect main rolls and access bearing grease fittings per SOP-P1-L1-05. Lubricate main roll bearings at the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01): 120 hours. Use lubricant specified in the asset lubrication chart. Purge old grease until clean lubricant appears at bearing seals, then add manufacturer recommended quantity.
- Complete post-maintenance checks: verify guards, reset interlocks, and restore power per SB-1025.

Acceptance criteria
- All mandrel clamp bolts remain at set torque with no visible looseness and no damage to bolt threads or clamp seating.
- Main roll bearings show clean lubricant flow with no contamination visible at seals and no abnormal noise during run-up.
- Maintenance actions logged and cross-referenced to SOP-P1-L1-01, SOP-P1-L1-05, and SB-1025.
